result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback: it is mutual, applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services, lasts 12 months from the end of each individual's involvement, includes general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and prohibits solicitation rather than hiring. It appropriately removes the original one-way, 24-month no-hire without changing unrelated terms. Drafting is professional, though the final reference to an individual who “approaches the other party” is slightly ambiguous and would be clearer as “approaches the hiring party” or “approaches it.”
